_doc: NPC_AI_SPEC §5.1's `wander` / §1's decision/activities/Wander.js — the
one intrinsic id every archetype list in archetypes.json has offered
since phase 1 with no Action behind it (that file's own `_doc` said so in
as many words). Phase 8 gives it one; these are its tunables.
WHY PHASE 8 OWNS THIS. §10's build-order item 8 is 'LOD tiers + ambient'.
The ambient half already had `idle_fidget` (actions/ambient.ts) — but that
Activity emits PLAY_ANIM and ONLY PLAY_ANIM: it is standing-still
fidgeting, never locomotion, so 'background NPCs move around when nothing
else is going on' was still entirely Villagers.tsx's pre-AI cascade,
which only runs for a villager a renderer is actually mounting. A tier-D
agent (different region — every home villager the moment the player steps
through a portal) has no renderer at all, so it had nothing to do AND
nothing to do it with. Wander is what tier D's coarse stepping carries,
and the action gates itself to exactly that set — see wander.ts's header
for why anything wider would starve four shipped Villagers.tsx branches.
radius / minRadius are Villagers.tsx's own WANDER_RADIUS (14) and its
`2 + Math.random() * (WANDER_RADIUS - 2)` ring, reproduced exactly rather
than re-guessed — the same 'reuse the shipped target selection, move only
the DECISION into the reasoner' rule flee.ts/sleep.ts already followed
(see data/villagers.ts's HOME_X extraction comment).
stopDistance 0.5 sits between that cascade's own 0.4 arrival check and
flee/sleep's 0.6; samples is how many candidate points are tried before
giving up for this attempt (each one costs a single NavGrid.isWalkable).
pauseSec is the cooldown after a completed stroll, and is what makes this
read as ambient life rather than as pacing: while it holds, idle_fidget
(ambient too, cooldown 8) is the only thing left that can win, so the
cascade's own `pause = 5 + Math.random()*9` stand-and-look-around beat
falls out of composing two actions instead of out of a third timer. 6 sits
just under that 8 so the two do not lock step.
giveUpSec ends a wander that is making no progress AND cannot say so. The
coarse-step branch does report `blocked` (Locomotion.jumpAlongPath, when a
jump's landing point has no walkable cell near it) and the Activity ends on
that immediately; what has no status of its own is an agent pressed into a
corner with no path at all, since navSteer then falls back to straight-line
steering and keeps reporting `moving` while covering no ground. 30 s is a
clock for that case only — long enough never to cut a real stroll short at
0.9 m/s across a 14 m ring.
